title: Vonoprazan and Amoxicillin
overview: Vonoprazan and amoxicillin are used to eliminate H. pylori, a type of bacteria that causes ulcers (sores in the lining of the stomach or intestine). Vonoprazan is in a class of medications called potassium-competitive acid blockers (PCAB). Amoxicillin is in a class of medications called antibiotics. Vonoprazan works by decreasing the amount of acid made in the stomach. Amoxicillin work by stopping the growth of the bacteria that may cause ulcers. Antibiotics will not work for colds, flu, or other viral infections.

sections.Before taking vonoprazan and amoxicillin: tell your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to vonoprazan; amoxicillin; penicillin antibiotics; cephalosporin antibiotics such as cefaclor, cefadroxil, cefdinir, cefixime, cefpodoxime, cefprozil, cefuroxime, and cephalexin; any other medications; or any of the ingredients in vonoprazan tablets or amoxicillin capsules. Ask your pharmacist for a list of the ingredients.Some medications should not be taken with vonoprazan and amoxicillin. Other medications may cause dosing changes or extra monitoring when taken with vonoprazan and amoxicillin. Make sure you have discussed any medications you are currently taking or plan to take with your doctor and pharmacist before starting vonoprazan and amoxicillin. Before starting, stopping or changing any medications while taking vonoprazan and amoxicillin, get the advice of your healthcare provider.The following nonprescription or herbal products may interact with vonoprazan and amoxicillin: St. John's wort. Be sure to let your doctor and pharmacist know that you are taking this medication before you start taking vonoprazan and amoxicillin. Do not start this medication while taking vonoprazan and amoxicillin without discussing with your healthcare providertell your doctor if you have or have ever had mononucleosis (a virus; also called 'mono'), or kidney or liver disease.tell your doctor if you are pregnant or plan to become pregnant. If you become pregnant while taking vonoprazan and amoxicillin, call your doctor.tell your doctor if you are breast-feeding. You should not breastfeed while taking vonoprazan and amoxicillin and for 2 days after your final dose.
